name: Lord of Skulls

bonuses.name: Towering Monstrosity
bonuses.text: This Threat is huge and heavily armoured. It has 50 Wounds.

bonuses.name: Daemon Engine
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat's Turns, it heals 2d3 Wounds.

bonuses.name: Reckless Fury
bonuses.text: This Threat may fire its ranged weapons in close combat. If there are fewer enemies than half the Blast rating, or on a Complication, the Lord of Skulls is also hit.

abilities.name: Rage Incarnate
abilities.text: Anyone who sees a Lord of Skulls must make a DN 4 Fear Test.

determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 9d6. Daemons can roll Determinationagainst Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

options.name: Lord of Skulls Options
options.text: A Lord of Skulls can field multiple weapon configurations. The arm cannon may be replaced with a Skullhurler, and the torso mounted cannon may be replaced with either a Gorestorm Cannon or Daemongore Cannon.

note: Daemon Engine printed in the normal threat format. Print error copied: Determination reads 'Determinationagainst' (missing space). Ranged weapons print no Salvo.
